title: [18/2/2023] The average cost of monthly contract for four different mobile
prompt: The chart below shows the average cost of monthly contract for four different mobile (cell phones) in a European country from January to September 2002, measured in euro.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The line graph illustrates the monthly subscription costs of four mobile phone providers in a European country over a nine-month period in 2002, measured in euros.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, while most providers maintained relatively stable prices throughout the period, ALPHA showed the most dramatic change, rising from the lowest to the highest position. Additionally, DOMO consistently remained the most expensive option for most of the period shown.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Regarding the providers with the most significant price changes, in January, DOMO charged approximately 15 euros for its monthly subscription, which was three times higher than ALPHA's rate of about 5 euros. DOMO then showed a gradual increase to about 18 euros in March, before experiencing minor fluctuations and ending at roughly 23 euros in September. Meanwhile, ALPHA maintained relatively stable prices until June, after which it rose sharply to become the most expensive provider at about 25 euros by the end of the period.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: Regarding the other two providers, LEX started at about 12 euros in January, while SIM TX began at a lower rate of approximately 8 euros. The former maintained a relatively steady upward trend to reach approximately 18 euros in September. Similarly, the latter showed minimal variations throughout the period, finishing at about 7 euros.
